column1: Master switch for every OMS adapter (Pancake POS and later adapters). When No, the place-order observer and the 10-minute retry cron do not push any order. Each adapter still has its own enable flag. Default: Yes. No external data is required.

column1: How many times Magento retries a failed outbound push. Source: local config only (not read from Pancake). Cron secomm_fulfillmentcore_retry_failed_export runs every 10 minutes and retries rows in secomm_fulfillment_export with push_status pending or failed until this count. Default: 5. After the limit, fix the adapter error (for example warehouse_unmapped) then the row is not retried automatically.
